state: **Side goal `compare-page`, stage 2 in progress.** The Docker half of the containerised legs is its own module, `tools/nv/cmd/bench-docker.ts`: `requireDocker`, `compose`, `up`, `down`, `logsOf`, `ohaOnce`, `ohaArm` (driven by a `Load` of requests, concurrency and reps) and `messageOf`. `bench-proxied` imports it and is unchanged in behaviour. It lives under `cmd/` beside `bench.ts`, not `lib/`, because it imports `Fail`, `round` and `median` from `cmd/bench.ts`. `bench-compare` and `benches/compare/` do not exist yet. `benches/proxied/README.md` stays the home of that leg's decisions.

next.title: four peers behind one TLS proxy

items.text: **The peer table and `bench-compare`**: one entry per peer (Novis, PHP-FPM, Bun, Go), its compose file and nginx upstream with TLS 1.3, `memory.peak` per fresh container, and `--smoke`. Import the stack helpers from `bench-docker.ts`; register the command in `tools/nv/main.ts`. Anchor: `tools/nv/cmd/bench-proxied.ts:283`, `tools/nv/cmd/bench-docker.ts:1`.
**`benches/compare/README.md`**: the home of why the comparison is built the way it is, pointing at `benches/proxied/README.md` for what it shares. Anchor: `benches/proxied/README.md:1`.
